tool.name: MRD sample sheet check report
tool.description: HTML page with what to fix

param.name: report
param.label: Sample sheet check report
param.help: The 'Sample sheet check report' output of the sample sheet check workflow.

param.name: edits
param.label: Automatic edits per sample
param.help: Optional. The 'Automatic edits per sample' output; samples with edits are listed and marked.

param.name: sheet
param.label: Corrected sample sheet
param.help: Optional. Shown at the end, with the samples that have problems or edits marked.

param.name: run_name
param.label: Run name
param.help: Shown in the header, e.g. MRD2026-038.

Primer did not match the location
Every primer is in the primer table
Sheet can be used: no problems, no corrections

tool.help:
**What it does**
Turns the outputs of the MRD sample sheet check into one HTML page for the wet lab:
- a traffic light: green (no problems, no corrections), orange (corrected automatically, can be used), red (problems to fix by hand before the run); - one card per problem type, with what to do and the samples concerned (wrong number of columns, notation, unknown primer or MID, repeated MID combination, marker unknown to TransVar, primer and transcript of different genes, marker outside the amplicon of the primer, DNA position or protein not fitting the transcript); - the automatic corrections per sample; - the corrected sample sheet with the affected samples marked.
The page needs no internet connection.
